attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Acrobatics skill + 1d4.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1.

On your combat check, if you played a weapon and it does not have the 2-Handed trait, you may discard this card to add 1d4 and the Piercing trait.
